mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCdAgentPrimaryActivityDetailRegPopList*/ SELECT AGENT, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY IC WHERE IC.COM_CODE = BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, VISIT_DATE, VISIT_TIME, STATUS, VISIT_TYPE, VISIT_NOTE, IMAGE_KEY, ADD_USER_DEPT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(VISIT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS T_VISIT_DATE, TO_VISIT_TIME, KEP_CFRC_NM, AGENT_CFRC_RM, CFRC_PLACE, ADD_USER_ID, AGENT_NAME, IRS_NO FROM KEP_AGENT_VISIT WHERE 1=1 AND AGENT = #{com_code} AND ADD_DATE = #{add_date} AND ADD_TIME = #{add_time} AND STATUS != 'D'
mapper.update: /* insertMasterMdCdAgentPrimaryActivityDetailRegPop */ INSERT INTO KEP_AGENT_VISIT( AGENT, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, BUYER, VISIT_DATE, VISIT_TIME, STATUS, VISIT_TYPE, VISIT_NOTE, IMAGE_KEY, ADD_USER_ID, ADD_USER_DEPT, TO_VISIT_TIME, KEP_CFRC_NM, AGENT_CFRC_RM, CFRC_PLACE, AGENT_NAME, IRS_NO ) VALUES( #{com_code}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #{st_buyer}, #{st_visit_date}, #{st_visit_time}, 'C', #{st_visit_type}, #{st_agent_remark}, #{st_image_key}, #{st_user_id}, (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}), #{st_visit_to_time}, #{st_kep_rspn_text}, #{st_agent_rspn_text}, #{st_place_text}, #{st_agent_name}, #{st_agent_irs_no} )

/* updateMasterMdCdAgentPrimaryActivityDetailRegPop */ UPDATE KEP_AGENT_VISIT A SET A.BUYER = #{st_buyer}, A.VISIT_DATE = #{st_visit_date}, A.VISIT_TIME = #{st_visit_time}, A.VISIT_TYPE = #{st_visit_type}, A.VISIT_NOTE = #{st_agent_remark}, A.IMAGE_KEY = #{st_image_key}, A.TO_VISIT_TIME = #{st_visit_to_time}, A.KEP_CFRC_NM = #{st_kep_rspn_text}, A.AGENT_CFRC_RM = #{st_agent_rspn_text}, A.CFRC_PLACE = #{st_place_text}, A.AGENT_NAME = #{st_agent_name}, A.IRS_NO = #{st_agent_irs_no} WHERE A.AGENT = #{com_code} AND A.ADD_DATE = #{add_date} AND A.ADD_TIME = #{add_time} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'
